verdict.line: You win by forcing all-ins while Blinding Dart (8s cooldown) is down and closing the game before 9; you lose if lane goes passive and Teemo's poke plus mushroom zoning drag it past 20 minutes, which tracks with Renekton's 46.4% win rate here over 1267 games despite holding lane and solo-kill advantage.

brief.thesis: Renekton's entire edge is the pre-6 all-in: Teemo has no hard CC and only an 8-second Q (Blinding Dart) to stop a Fury-stacked W (Ruthless Predator) stun-chain. But once Teemo hits 6 and starts planting R (Noxious Trap) mushrooms, those poison-cloud zones plus stacking E (Toxic Shot) on-hit damage let him kite and siege from range, which is why the aggregate win rate (46.4%) sits below Renekton's overall baseline (49.6%) even though the lane and kill-pressure metrics favor him.

theirWindow.when: Right after he lands Q (Blind) on you
theirWindow.what: Your autos whiff for the blind's duration, so you can't generate Fury past 50 to threaten the 3-hit empowered W. Disengage instead of trading autos blind — he's free-hitting you with Toxic Shot stacks while you do nothing.

yourWindow.what: Commit immediately: auto twice to build Fury, W (Ruthless Predator) for the stun, E (Slice and Dice) to stick through his kite, Q (Cull the Meek) to heal off the trade. This is the only window where he can't blind your way out of the chain.

start.why: Run at the 46.1% win rate, 77.1% pick start — the flat damage reduction on the first hit from each champion blunts his early Q poke and the passive HP regen offsets Toxic Shot's damage-over-time between trades.

boots.why: 80.2% pick, 46.4% win rate — Teemo's entire kit (Blinding Dart, Toxic Shot, Noxious Trap cloud) is magic damage, and the tenacity shortens how long the mushroom slow pins you in the cloud.

core.why: Highest win rate core path (49.2% with this sequence) — the shield proc and burst let you win the Fury-stacked all-in trade outright instead of trading evenly.
Armor shred stacks with your empowered E's own Armor reduction, turning short all-ins into sustained DPS windows if he tries to just run.
Converts a chunk of incoming damage to a heal-over-time, which specifically answers Teemo's poison — Toxic Shot stacks and mushroom cloud ticks — instead of burning you down over the fight.

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror stacks over the extended trade your all-in creates and converts to healing, directly offsetting the poison DoT from Toxic Shot and Noxious Trap that otherwise outlasts you in prolonged skirmishes.

summoners.why: Run at 46.3% win rate and 73.6% pick — Ignite closes out the pre-6 all-in window before Teemo's Move Quick lets him kite out of kill range, and punishes his low early HP pool directly.

playing.title: Track the Blind cooldown
playing.detail: Blinding Dart is only 8 seconds — note the moment he uses it and start your all-in timer immediately, since your whole combo depends on landing autos to build Fury.

playing.title: All-in before level 6
playing.detail: Once W (rank 2, 14s cooldown) and E are both up, dash in with E, auto twice for Fury, then W for the double-slash stun. Teemo has nothing to punish this short of the Q he's already spent.

playing.title: Save R for clean kills
playing.detail: Dominus's bonus Health and AoE pulse let you commit through a blind without dying — hold it for a window where Blinding Dart is already down, not as your opener.

playing.title: Don't facecheck invis brush
playing.detail: A stationary Teemo goes invisible via Camouflage after a short delay. Ward river and tri-brush entrances so a stealthed mushroom-plus-ambush doesn't flip a trade you were winning.

playing.title: Respect mushroom zones after 6
playing.detail: Noxious Trap only has a 1-second cooldown per cast, so once he's planted a few around river or objective entrances, don't walk sieges through blind — bait the cloud with a minion or ward first.

playing.title: Freeze waves, bait his poke
playing.detail: Your advantage is the all-in, not the ranged exchange. Hold the wave near your tower so he has to walk up into your Q/E range instead of you shoving into his 680-range poke.

playing.title: Rush MR if poked down
playing.detail: If you're losing the lane to sustained Toxic Shot and Blinding Dart chip rather than dying to all-ins, finish Mercury's Treads before completing Eclipse.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner picks, and every win-rate and pick-rate figure above come from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning, timings, and trade patterns are my own read of the two kits.
